name: Stinville et al. 2022 Inconel 718 multi-modal dataset: in situ SEM HR-DIC at four plastic strain levels, 2D EBSD registered to DIC, TriBeam 3D EBSD with raw .up2 Kikuchi patterns and BSE/SE slice images (Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.83bk3j9sj, CC0; descriptor Sci Data 2022 doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01525-w)
state: prospective, filled 2026-10-06 from repository metadata (DataCite, Dryad API, Zenodo, Crossref) and descriptor pages; nothing downloaded or measured. descriptor_paper true means an open-access descriptor exists, not yet on the build host

readers.notes: 16-bit TIFF SEM tiles and 32-bit TIFF HR-DIC fields (tifffile); 2D EBSD .ang (orix, kikuchipy) with .osc duplicate (EDAX binary, MTEX only); raw patterns .up2 (kikuchipy EDAX binary reader); 3D .dream3d HDF5 with .xdmf (h5py, DREAM.3D, ParaView); meshes .inp and .vtk (meshio) and Ansys APDL text decks. 11 files, about 69 GB. Raw SEM DIC tiles are described in the descriptor; the Dryad list shows no separate raw-tile archive, so confirm in README_file.txt which zip holds them (or BisQue)

calibration.notes: SEM tiles 4096 x 4096 px, HFW 137 um, 33.4 nm pixel, 20 kV, 20 us dwell; HR-DIC step 3 px = 100.34 nm, subset 31 px; 2D EBSD 0.7 um step at 20 kV; TriBeam 1 um cubic voxels, 526 slices

observables.name: in-plane slip amplitude, slip direction and effective strain per slip band (Heaviside HR-DIC fields)
observables.notes: second route: slip traces visible in the deposited BSE images; descriptor says every DIC slip event sits where the BSE images show it

observables.name: area-averaged DIC strain against macroscopic strain (stress-strain data provided)
observables.notes: authors report differences of -0.68% to +0.29% across load steps

observables.name: grain orientation and grain/twin boundaries (2D EBSD .ang and 3D TriBeam EBSD)
observables.notes: second route: re-index the raw .up2 patterns (authors used EMsoft dictionary indexing; the Dryad archive is named Up2_2slices, so coverage may be two slices); authors report 7% surface-area mismatch between 3D reconstruction and 2D EBSD and 1.6 deg misorientation on a tested grain

observables.name: slip trace angle per grain (Hough on DIC maps) against slip plane traces from EBSD orientation
grain reference orientation deviation per voxel (3D EBSD)

series.factor: macroscopic plastic strain 0.17, 0.32, 0.61, 1.26 % on the same 8 x 8 tile region (single precipitation-hardened specimen, about 1 x 1 mm2)

laws.name: Schmid law: highest-Schmid {111}<110> plane from EBSD orientation and the tensile axis predicts the DIC slip trace angle per grain
area-averaged DIC strain equals macroscopic strain (compatibility identity)
mean slip amplitude or localization intensity against macroscopic strain (power law)

co_registered: 2D EBSD (polynomial distortion correction, resampled onto the DIC grid)
TriBeam 3D EBSD below the DIC region with BSE every 30 slices and SE at 30 deg tilt; raw .up2 patterns in an archive named Up2_2slices (may hold two slices only, check README)
